scope: All 33 declarations in pkg/document/document_test.go. In-memory getters and selected save/reopen assertions are distinct. Two nine-row CommonFixtures loops are unmapped smoke checks; one symbol/page-break smoke is unmapped. Existing direct font-size ID is a narrower in-memory overlap only. Source-only, no canonical execution or OOXML conformance credit.

limits: SaveDocument/OpenDocument fail on errors; Close errors ignored
CommonFontSizeCases HalfPts metadata is not asserted by document_test.go

verifiedAspects: New returns a document with nonnil Body and no paragraphs or tables
gaps: Only initial in-memory state; no save or package membership check

Nine CommonFixtures setups empty, single_paragraph, multiple_paragraphs, formatted_text, headings, simple_table, mixed_content, unicode_content, sdt_content_controls run SaveAs and Open via fatal-on-error helper methods; no reopened content/size assertions. Setup specifics and Close errors are not verified; no canonical behavior is assigned to this smoke test.
